title: Somme lungo gli assi
code:
import numpy as np
M = np.array([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]])
print(M.sum(axis=0), M.max(axis=1))
codeHtml: import numpy as np M = np.array([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]) print(M.sum(axis=0), M.max(axis=1))
explain: axis=0 riduce lungo le righe (una somma per colonna); axis=1 lungo le colonne (un massimo per riga).
